name: Multi-store refunds
productType: Excel summary, CSV dataset, and DAX measures
audience: A retailer who wants refunds visible on their own.
summary: Refund amounts by store. Refunds are not subtracted from a sales table that is not here.
description: Refund amounts by store. Refunds are not subtracted from a sales table that is not here. Load the CSV into Excel or Power BI Desktop. The DAX file is text you paste into a measure. This package does not include a PBIX file.

DAX that names the columns in that CSV
An Excel total you can check against the rows

Power BI Desktop if you paste the DAX yourself
